notes.page_summary: The author wants the usual six operations on sheaves over X or a union of its strata expressed in the proposed dictionary and their known formulas reverified. He says it will probably be necessary to start with the category of diagrams of semi-simplicial sets and then pass to a homotopical category of fractions. He next recalls his recent work on topologie modérée and begins saying that an equisingular stratification of a compact espace modéré canonically gives a diagram of spaces. The last assertion continues beyond this page; nothing is completed from another sheet.
